memories.author: D06
memories.text: Allergy: penicillin – rash and pruritus noted after amoxicillin course for sinusitis two years ago. Avoid all beta-lactam antibiotics.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks to bus stop, manages own medication.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5, no impairment noted.
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 10 regular (metformin 500 mg BD, glimepiride 1 mg OD, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD). Five or more is polypharmacy – request review against Beers criteria.
mood: Denies low mood or anxiety; PHQ-2 not performed today.
carers: Priya Kulkarni, spouse.
goal: "I want to stay active enough to drive my school bus and enjoy time with my grandchildren."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 7.8% (target <7.0). Fasting plasma glucose 146 mg/dL (70-110). Urine albumin-creatinine ratio 45 mg/g (<30). Serum creatinine 1.3 mg/dL (0.6-1.2). eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60). Haemoglobin 13.8 g/dL (13-17). TSH 2.1 µIU/mL (0.4-4.0).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Metformin increased to 500 mg TID (from BD). Glimepiride unchanged. Sitagliptin unchanged. Empagliflozin unchanged.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Still independent; reports mild fatigue after long bus routes.
cognition: Mini-Cog not repeated (annual due next April).
falls: No falls; gait slightly slower; timed up-and-go 11 seconds (borderline).
medicines: 10 regular (metformin 500 mg TID, glimepiride 1 mg OD, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD). Polypharmacy – medication review pending.
mood: Reports occasional low mood; denies suicidal ideation.
carers: Priya Kulkarni, spouse.
goal: "I would like to reduce tiredness so I can finish my routes without needing naps."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 7.5% (down from 7.8). Fasting plasma glucose 132 mg/dL. Urine albumin-creatinine ratio 38 mg/g (improving). Serum creatinine 1.28 mg/dL. eGFR 55 mL/min/1.73m2. Haemoglobin 13.6 g/dL.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Dr Srinivasan, Ophthalmology, for dilated fundus exam to assess diabetic retinopathy. Patient advised to attend within 4 weeks.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Ophthalmology report: Mild non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy, no macular edema. Recommend annual retinal review. Glycaemic control to be optimised.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for Dr Nandini Kulkarni on 2026-02-05 at 10:30 AM for routine geriatric review.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Manages bus route but notes needing rest after shift; uses walking aid occasionally for knee discomfort.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (annual screen), negative.
falls: One fall in kitchen 3 months ago (slipped on water), no injury; gait cautious; timed up-and-go 13 seconds (raised fall risk). Plan: home safety review, strength exercises, supportive footwear.
medicines: 10 regular (metformin 500 mg TID, glimepiride 1 mg OD, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD). Polypharmacy – medication review scheduled.
mood: Reports improved sleep; denies depression.
carers: Priya Kulkarni, spouse.
goal: "I want to stay steady on my feet and avoid any more falls."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 7.2% (target <7.0). Fasting plasma glucose 124 mg/dL. Urine albumin-creatinine ratio 32 mg/g. Serum creatinine 1.25 mg/dL. eGFR 57 mL/min/1.73m2. Haemoglobin 13.5 g/dL.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Glimepiride stopped due to hypoglycemic episodes (two events with symptomatic low glucose). All other medications continued unchanged.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Bus driving tolerated with occasional shortness of breath on inclines; uses inhaler as needed for mild wheeze.
cognition: Mini-Cog not due yet.
falls: No further falls; gait steady; timed up-and-go 12 seconds (borderline raised risk). Continue exercise and footwear advice.
medicines: 9 regular (metformin 500 mg TID, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD). Polypharmacy – review pending.
mood: Reports occasional anxiety about bus schedule; denies depression.
carers: Priya Kulkarni, spouse.
goal: "I hope to keep my breath steady so I can finish routes without stopping."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 7.0% (at target). Fasting plasma glucose 115 mg/dL. Urine albumin-creatinine ratio 28 mg/g (normal). Serum creatinine 1.22 mg/dL. eGFR 60 mL/min/1.73m2. Haemoglobin 13.7 g/dL.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Resting ECG: Normal sinus rhythm, rate 78 bpm. No ST-T changes, no Q waves. Left ventricular voltage within normal limits. No arrhythmia detected.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: "I’ve been waking up at 3 am most nights and can’t get back to sleep. The melatonin isn’t helping as much; I feel tired during my morning shift."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports improved energy after adjusting sleep regimen; bus routes completed without rest.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (annual), negative.
falls: No falls in past year; gait normal; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 9 regular (metformin 500 mg TID, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD). Polypharmacy – medication review completed, no Beers‑inappropriate drugs.
mood: Denies low mood; anxiety improved with sleep hygiene.
carers: Priya Kulkarni, spouse.
goal: "I want to keep sleeping well and stay active for my family."
